== Biography ==
'''John Glasgow''' was born on 02 Aug 1741 and baptised at Irvine, Ayrshire, on 06 Aug 1741. The parish register names his father as [[Glasgow-4157|James Glasgow]] and his mother as [[Nasmith-37|Helen Nasmith]].<ref name="FMP1" /> The register records both dates; Irvine is inferred from the baptism and is not independently recorded.

John Glasgow was one of the children recorded to James Glasgow and Helen Nasmith in the Irvine register, alongside [[Glasgow-4110|Allan]] (1743), [[Glasgow-4128|Susanna]] (1747).

== Research Notes ==
=== Irvine baptism household ===

James [[Glasgow-4157]] is the documented father of Allan [[Glasgow-4110]] at 98% subjective confidence. Allan’s maintained Findmypast baptism transcript explicitly names James Glasgow and Helen Nasmith at Irvine on 22 May 1743, with birth on 15 May. James-4157 is the existing adult account defined by this same three-child household, not a name-only match to a separately known shipmaster. John’s 1741 baptism names James Glasgow and Helen Nasmith, and Susanna’s 1747 entry names Jas Glasgow and Helen Macsmith. The shared parish, father, maternal forename and compatible sequence support one household, with Macsmith retained as the indexed maternal variant. Allan’s own entry supplies the father directly; the siblings independently support the identification.

The 98% applies to the father of these record-defined children, allowing for derivative transcription and an uninspected original. The saved Findmypast transcripts were captured on 3 September 2026 and are reused here; no original or new source is claimed inspected today. This neither identifies James with the Prosperity shipmaster in 1740 nor gives him a named father. Other Irvine James profiles remain compatible comparisons for those distinct identity questions. No birth, death, occupation, marriage, mother or upstream parent is inferred from this decision.

Inspect the original Irvine OPR595/1 entries for the maternal Macsmith/Nasmith reading and any residence, occupation or witnesses that distinguish James’s birth family. His before-1722 birth remains an adult-age estimate. The 1711 Irvine James, son of John Glasgow and Isabell Kelle, and the 1721 James, son of James and Margaret Rae, are compatible later-identity comparisons; neither is selected solely from name, age or parish.<ref name="IrvineHousehold2026">[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3575071&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland Parish Births & Baptisms, Irvine OPR595/1, John Glasgow, 6 August 1741, SCOT/OPR/BAP/3575071; maintained 3 September 2026 transcript]; [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3575202&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland Parish Births & Baptisms, Irvine OPR595/1, Allan Glasgow, 22 May 1743, SCOT/OPR/BAP/3575202; maintained 3 September 2026 transcript]; [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3575478&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland Parish Births & Baptisms, Irvine OPR595/1, Susanna Glasgow, 29 March 1747, SCOT/OPR/BAP/3575478; maintained 3 September 2026 transcript].</ref>


The baptism is the only record found for John Glasgow. A search of live WikiTree profiles found no compatible match; [[Glasgow-3314|John]] belongs to a different family and is not this person.
